name: Baby Feeder Philips Avent Natural Response Baby Feeder Bottle 1m+ 260ml Pack of 2
description:
Philips Avent Natural Feeder Bottle 
1m+ 
260ml 
(Pack of 2) 
MADE IN INDONESIA 
PLASTIC BOTTLE 
Easy to combine with breastfeeding 
0% BPA1 
Anti-colic valve designed to reduce colic and discomfort 
Wide breast-shaped teat for natural latch on 
Ultra-soft teat mimics the feel of the breast 
Ultra-soft and flexible
